text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like it's time for training. 
Well then, I'll take my leave ahead of 
ya."

text_block_list.name: Opponent
text_block_list.text:
""I've been on a huge losing streak 
lately, and I don't know what to do 
anymore. Could you give me some advice?""

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho... You've got great taste relying on 
me. Very well, I shall personally give you 
some advice!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The reason for your defeat is that you 
got fixated on short-term gains, clouding 
your view of the entire board. In other 
words—"

text_block_list.name: Opponent
text_block_list.text:
"With that tactic, won't we be at a 
disadvantage when we make our move?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm! You could certainly look at it that 
way. Aren't you quite sharp...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Then how about a strategy like this? 
Anticipate the moment your opponent makes 
a move, and—..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While caught up in a heated debate, 
Rulership ended up skipping training 
entirely.
